entities.name: Imre Varga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Imre Varga was a Hungarian sculptor, painter, designer and graphic artist. He was regarded as one of Hungary's most important living artists,
and he has been called one of the "most skilled sculptors in Hungary."
